title: Adjunct Instructor of Economics
description:
Description

The Adjunct Economics Instructor is responsible for providing
quality Economics instruction to students in a face-to-face format.
The instructor will be responsible for teaching Principles of
Microeconomics, Principles of Macroeconomics, and upper level
Economics electives to Economics and non-Economics majors. The
instructor should be well-versed in economic concepts such as the
price mechanism, supply and demand, money and banking, governmental
intervention, and trade.

Qualifications

A master’s in economics or a related field (with completed 18
credit hours in Economics at the graduate level, or relevant
economics-related experience).

Application Instructions

Pl ease send your CV, Cover Letter, and List of Courses taught to
Dr. Blen Solomon at bsolomon@flagler.edu.

https://apply.interfolio.com/196316
